title: API proxy configuration reference
reviewNotes: Reviewed base, proxy, target, and integration endpoint sections, including names, versions, routes, local routing, TLS, and authentication. The supplemental Apigee tutorial now supports BasePaths and Policy/ProxyEndpoint/TargetEndpoint manifest children; Resources and TargetServers manifest children remain unspecified. TargetEndpoint connection and RouteRule alternatives are now checked for at-most-one selection. Authentication follows the explicitly identical ServiceCallout contract, and LoadBalancer follows the separate guide. Remaining HTTP connection details and ScriptTarget are not fully specified; TLS dependencies are not linted. The ProxyEndpoint charset property is included although absent from the endpoint property table. Flow and fault subtrees are tracked by the flow reference.

title: Flow configuration reference
reviewNotes: Reviewed PreFlow, Flows/Flow, PostFlow, EventFlow, PostClientFlow, Request/Response, Step, Condition, Name, and Description in both endpoint contexts. Flow names within one Flows container are now checked for uniqueness; Step Condition and Name are each limited to one. Static Step policy names are checked against policy XML names in the same local proxy bundle, but not against cloud resources. The Flows attribute table says there are no attributes although syntax/examples use name; the hierarchy lists Flows/Description although its child table does not; examples place Description under Request although its child table lists only Step. The API proxy reference also shows an empty PostClientFlow/Request although this page lists only Response, and calls Step/Name required whereas this page calls all Step children optional. These conflicts are accepted conservatively. Flow-name format checks only whitespace because 'special characters' is unspecified.

title: Endpoint properties reference
reviewNotes: Apigee X TargetEndpoint and ProxyEndpoint transport property names and documented value types are modeled in their respective XML contexts. The hybrid-only use.proxy and use.proxy.tunneling properties are deliberately excluded. Property values are literals; enum and documented format checks depend on the Property name attribute.

title: Load balancing across backend servers
reviewNotes: Reviewed TargetEndpoint and ServiceCallout LoadBalancer XML, including algorithms, servers, weights, fallback, failure handling, retry, and path. The documented at-most-one fallback server is now checked in both contexts. The Weighted prose calls weight an attribute but its XML example uses a Weight child; the child is modeled and Server remains incomplete to avoid rejecting a potentially valid attribute. A LeastConnections example places Path outside HTTPTargetConnection, whereas other examples place it inside; only the latter is modeled. Weight value range and algorithm-dependent requirements are not statically checked because the weight representation is contradictory. Retry effectiveness with one server is runtime guidance, not a deployment error. Target-server API and health-monitor administration are outside proxy-bundle XML scope.

title: Semantic caching with a private endpoint
reviewNotes: The current Apigee tutorial's proxy-bundle descriptor example confirms Policies/Policy, ProxyEndpoints/ProxyEndpoint, TargetEndpoints/TargetEndpoint, and BasePaths syntax. These manifest paths are modeled in the APIProxy document; the tutorial's semantic-caching setup and environment guidance are not XML lint rules.

title: access control policy
reviewNotes: Reviewed all AccessControl XML elements, attributes, value sets, mask bounds, and IPv4/IPv6 source-address format. Literal addresses are validated while message templates remain allowed. The mask range depends on the address family, and zero is valid only with 0.0.0.0; those cross-value relationships are not linted. ValidateBasedOn has a documented runtime dependency on IgnoreTrueClientIPHeader=true, and the Apigee X X-Forwarded-For security caveats are runtime guidance, not static XML errors. No deprecated element was found on this page.

title: access entity policy
reviewNotes: Reviewed Apigee policy elements, attributes, and supported entity and identifier values. OutputFormat is hybrid-only and excluded. EntityIdentifier versus Identifiers and type combinations are conditional, so those relationships are not linted.

title: assert condition policy
reviewNotes: Reviewed the policy's documented elements, common attributes, and required Condition child for Apigee. Condition expression syntax is free text and not validated.

title: assign message policy
reviewNotes: Apigee X AssignMessage operations are modeled by path: Add, Copy, Remove, Set, AssignTo, and AssignVariable. Set/Payload now explicitly permits arbitrary XML without being classified as unreviewed; documented Payload attributes remain linted. AssignVariable/Name is single, and Set/Authentication requires exactly one documented Google token child. The UI default includes an undocumented Properties subtree. One example puts Payload directly under AssignMessage although the element reference nests it under Set; that example is accepted conservatively with an incomplete context. An Add/FormParam direct-child example also conflicts with grouped FormParams syntax, so both are accepted. Authentication examples contain malformed closing tags; the consistently described nested forms are modeled. Request/response runtime restrictions and AssignVariable precedence are not static XML errors.

title: basic authentication policy
reviewNotes: Reviewed Apigee policy elements, required attributes, and documented values. AssignTo and Source are operation-dependent; the current rule model does not enforce their conditional requiredness.

title: cors policy
reviewNotes: Reviewed Apigee CORS elements, required AllowOrigins, boolean values, and MaxAge integer format. Free-form header, method, and origin lists remain unconstrained.

title: data capture policy
reviewNotes: Reviewed the documented nested capture elements and attributes for Apigee. Collect default is not enforced as required because the same page describes behavior when it is omitted. Conditional source selection and unique DataCollector references are not modeled.

title: decode jws policy
reviewNotes: Reviewed the Apigee DecodeJWS root attributes and optional DisplayName and Source elements. Signature and token contents are runtime concerns and are not linted.

title: decode jwt policy
reviewNotes: Reviewed the Apigee DecodeJWT root attributes and optional DisplayName and Source elements. JWT decoding and signature semantics are runtime concerns and are not linted.

title: delete oauth v2 info
reviewNotes: Reviewed documented Apigee elements and attributes. The example includes <Attributes/> but the page does not define its structure, so that context stays incomplete. AccessToken versus AuthorizationCode is an either/or requirement not represented by the current data model.

title: external callout policy
reviewNotes: Reviewed Apigee gRPC callout elements, authentication options, required server and timeout, and fixed Property names. Configurations child requiredness is not enforced because the page's FlowVariable-only example conflicts with its required-child table.

title: extract variables policy
reviewNotes: Reviewed all documented Apigee element contexts, required attributes, and fixed variable types. At-least-one extraction source is an either/or constraint not expressible by the current rule model. Pattern and XPath expression semantics are not validated.

title: flow callout policy
reviewNotes: Reviewed Apigee FlowCallout elements, required SharedFlowBundle, and Parameter attributes. The alternative parameter value sources (ref, value, or text) are documented but not cross-validated.

title: generate jws policy
reviewNotes: Reviewed Apigee GenerateJWS elements, algorithms, fixed header/key values, and key references. Exactly one key branch and its algorithm match are conditional and not enforced by the current rule model.

title: generate jwt policy
reviewNotes: Reviewed signed and encrypted Apigee JWT elements, attributes, and documented algorithms. CustomClaims is inserted by the UI but ignored and not structurally specified; it remains incomplete. Exactly-one algorithm/key branches and conditional PublicKey/Id are not expressible by the current rule model.

title: generate saml assertion policy
reviewNotes: Reviewed documented Apigee SAML generation structure, example attributes, and fixed signature/message values. CanonicalizationAlgorithm is shown but no value set is specified; its value is left unvalidated. OutputVariable branches and template conditions are not cross-validated.

title: get oauth v2 info policy
reviewNotes: Reviewed Apigee token selectors, their ref/literal forms, common policy attributes, and IgnoreAccessTokenStatus boolean. At-least-one selector and the AccessToken-only condition for IgnoreAccessTokenStatus are not cross-validated.

title: graphql policy
reviewNotes: Reviewed GraphQL elements and the documented Action and OperationType values. Conflicting requiredness for Source/OperationType and inconsistent units for MaxPayloadSizeInBytes are handled conservatively; conditional ResourceURL verification and GraphQL schema semantics are not linted.

title: hmac policy
reviewNotes: Reviewed Apigee HMAC required elements, algorithm aliases, case-insensitive encoding values, and optional verification. SecretKey ref must be a private variable at deployment, but flow-variable prefixes and message-template semantics are not cross-validated.

title: http modifier policy
reviewNotes: Reviewed Apigee Add/Remove/Set paths, AssignTo attributes, and documented HTTP verb/version values. UI template contains an unexplained Properties element, kept incomplete. Set/Path is documented as not working as designed. Context-dependent request/response constraints and templates are not cross-validated.

title: integration callout policy
reviewNotes: Reviewed Apigee IntegrationCallout children, required Request, and boolean execution/payload options. Preceding SetIntegrationRequest and IAM prerequisites are cross-policy/runtime conditions and are not linted.

title: invalidate cache policy
reviewNotes: Reviewed InvalidateCache elements, CacheKey requiredness, Scope enumeration, and optional ref/boolean values for Apigee. Prefix-versus-Scope precedence and conditional CacheContext values are not cross-validated.

title: java callout policy
reviewNotes: Reviewed JavaCallout required class and resource elements, common attributes, and literal Property names/values for Apigee. JAR existence, class loading, Java version, and runtime permissions are outside XML linting.

title: javascript policy
reviewNotes: Reviewed Apigee Javascript policy attributes, property/TLS children, and jsc resource URL format. ResourceURL-or-Source requiredness is an either/or constraint not represented by the current rule model; embedded JavaScript syntax and resource existence are not linted.

title: json threat protection policy
reviewNotes: Reviewed Apigee JSONThreatProtection limit elements, signed-integer semantics including negative values that disable limits, and Source values. Payload content type and actual JSON structure are runtime concerns.

title: json xml policy
reviewNotes: Reviewed JSONToXML elements and conversion Options for Apigee. Source and OutputVariable may be custom flow variables, so their text remains free; OutputVariable requiredness depends on Source type and is not cross-validated.

title: key value map operations policy
reviewNotes: Reviewed Apigee KVM operations, scope, cache interval, and context-specific literal versus ref values. Deprecated ExclusiveCache has no documented structure and remains incomplete. At-least-one operation, mapIdentifier/MapName exclusivity, and ref-versus-literal conditions are not cross-validated.

title: llm token quota policy
reviewNotes: Apigee-only policy. Reviewed documented quota types, nested Allow/Class/DefaultConfig structures, units, booleans, and sync interval. Examples conflict with prose about CountOnly/EnforceOnly and stepName requiredness, so these are not enforced; type-dependent and API-product conditions are not cross-validated.

title: lookup cache policy
reviewNotes: Reviewed Apigee LookupCache required CacheKey/AssignTo elements, cache-key fragments, Scope values, and nonnegative lookup timeout. CacheResource existence and matching PopulateCache key configuration are cross-policy/environment concerns.

title: message logging policy
reviewNotes: Reviewed CloudLogging and Syslog fields, enums, message attributes, and log levels. The page explicitly delegates Syslog SSLInfo to the TargetEndpoint TLS reference, so that nested structure is now modeled. CloudLogging/Syslog mutual exclusion and the TLS-requires-TCP condition are known cross-field limitations, not missing documentation.

title: message validation policy
reviewNotes: Reviewed MessageValidation root, Element namespace, SOAP versions, Source, and xsd/wsdl ResourceURL format. Properties appears in official default examples but has no described structure on this page, so it remains incomplete. Conditional SOAP/XSD requirements are not cross-validated.

title: monetization limits check policy
reviewNotes: Reviewed MonetizationLimitsCheck and documented FaultResponse branches. Payload may contain arbitrary XML (shown in official examples), so its nested content is deliberately open rather than treated as unknown Apigee tags. Monetization enablement is an environment prerequisite, not a static XML rule.

title: oas validation policy
reviewNotes: Reviewed OASResource formats and template allowance, required OASResource, option booleans, and Source values. Properties appears in the official default example without a described structure, so it remains incomplete. Existence and validity of the referenced OAS file require bundle/runtime context.

title: oauthv2 policy
reviewNotes: Reviewed OAuthV2 operation and grant-type enums, attributes, token settings, JWT keys, and nested token/attribute structures. PublicKey Certificate/JWKS forms are mentioned but not structured here, so remain incomplete. ClientId prose conflicts with later examples using other variables; ResponseType names a variable rather than a literal code/token. Operation-specific requirements are not cross-validated. Hybrid-only revoke_reason flow variable excluded.

title: parse dialogflow request policy
reviewNotes: Reviewed all documented XML elements and policy attributes. DialogflowVersion is restricted to CX by the documented deployment error; webhook JSON and generated flow variables are outside this XML schema.

title: parse payload policy
reviewNotes: Reviewed the Apigee-supported ParsePayload XML fields: request/response Source, JSON-RPC-2.0 PayloadType, and MCP Protocol. Message streaming and runtime version availability are deployment concerns, not XML value rules.

title: populate cache policy
reviewNotes: Reviewed cache key, source, scope, and expiration options and formats. Properties appears in the official example without a described structure and remains incomplete. Exactly-one expiry option and configured cache existence are not cross-validated.

title: prompt token limit policy
reviewNotes: Apigee-only policy. Reviewed Rate format, ref attributes, booleans, and prompt source. Properties appears in official examples without a structure. The page says UseEffectiveCount=false is unsupported for Apigee production while examples and defaults use false; this conflict is not enforced as a static error.

title: publish message policy
reviewNotes: Reviewed Pub/Sub topic format, custom message attributes, source variants, regional endpoint, and booleans. Source/UseMessageAsSource either-or, unique attribute names, topic existence, and Google authentication are not cross-validated. Attributes requiredness differs between the overview and detail table, so it is not enforced.

title: python script policy
reviewNotes: Reviewed the actual Script XML root, required Python ResourceURL, repeatable IncludeURL, and common policy attributes. Jython runtime behavior, plan availability, and referenced resource existence are outside local XML validation.

title: quota policy
reviewNotes: Reviewed nested Class and API-product default quota structures, counter options, numeric formats, and documented enums. Type default appears in the deployment error table though omitted from the introductory type list; second TimeUnit is documented for non-distributed counters. StartTime examples allow unpadded month/day despite yyyy-MM-dd prose. Conditional calendar StartTime, Class/Identifier exclusivity, CountOnly/EnforceOnly relationships, and API-product overrides are not cross-validated.

title: raise fault policy
reviewNotes: Reviewed RaiseFault response branches, headers, payload attributes, booleans, and ShortFaultReason. Payload deliberately allows arbitrary embedded XML and is left open to avoid false unknown-element errors; conditional fault behavior requires flow context.

title: read property set policy
reviewNotes: Reviewed repeatable Read operations, Name/Key ref-or-literal values, required AssignTo, optional DefaultValue, and IgnoreUnresolvedVariables. The deployment EmptyReads error establishes at least one Read despite the Read subsection's contradictory optional label; ref-or-literal nonempty conditions are not cross-validated.

title: regular expression protection
reviewNotes: Reviewed all element-reference paths, named parameter attributes, XML namespace prefix, XPath result types, JSON slash escaping, and deployment errors. The root requires one of several target selectors, but this cross-field alternative is not expressible as requiredChildren. Java regular-expression and XPath/JSONPath syntax are not validated.

title: reset quota policy
reviewNotes: Reviewed target Quota name/ref, mandatory Identifier, integer Allow adjustment, and optional class-specific counter adjustment. At least one of name/ref and one of direct Allow/Class is semantically needed, but these alternatives are not expressible by the static requiredChildren model.

title: response cache policy
reviewNotes: Reviewed cache keys, expiry alternatives, scope, flags, conditions, and documented attributes. The element-reference sample includes Properties but gives no definition of its possible children or attributes, so that subtree remains incomplete. Text formats may instead come from ref at runtime; condition expressions are not parsed.

title: revoke oauth v2 policy
reviewNotes: Reviewed AppId and EndUserId variable/literal forms, Cascade boolean, and epoch-millisecond RevokeBeforeTimestamp. The runtime EmptyAppAndEndUserId fault establishes a cross-element condition that the current static model cannot enforce; timestamp range and future checks remain runtime concerns.

title: sanitize llm response policy
reviewNotes: Reviewed the SanitizeModelResponse XML root, nested ModelArmor/TemplateName, prompt and response sources, optional function-call fallback, and boolean unresolved-variable setting. The high-level child table incorrectly implies TemplateName is directly under the root; syntax and deployment error confirm ModelArmor nesting. Message-template expressions remain free text.

title: sanitize user prompt policy
reviewNotes: Reviewed the SanitizeUserPrompt root, required ModelArmor/TemplateName, optional prompt extraction override and function-response fallback, and boolean unresolved-variable setting. The high-level child list incorrectly presents TemplateName directly under the root; examples and deployment error confirm nesting. Message-template expressions are free text.

title: semantic cache lookup policy
reviewNotes: Reviewed embedding and similarity-search VertexAI paths, public URL versus Apigee-supported PrivateServiceConnect/GrpcEndpoint, DeployedIndexID, and the four exact DistanceMeasureType values. The overview calls Embeddings required while its own detailed section says optional; no root requiredness diagnostic is emitted for it. Exactly one search transport is required but the current static model cannot enforce alternatives.

title: semantic cache populate policy
reviewNotes: Reviewed required SimilaritySearch/VertexAI/URL, optional TTLInSeconds, and boolean IgnoreUnresolvedVariables. Unlike lookup, PrivateServiceConnect is explicitly unsupported in populate and is not modeled. The TTL deployment description contradicts itself on zero (must be >=0 yet says zero fails), so no static range diagnostic is emitted.

title: service callout policy
reviewNotes: Reviewed callout root, request/response/timeout, HTTP versus local targets, and Google authentication subtree. SSLInfo is now modeled from the explicitly referenced TargetEndpoint TLS contract, and LoadBalancer is supplemented by the separate load-balancing guide. Request Remove/Copy/Add/Set inherits AssignMessage syntax and remains incomplete; transport Properties is not fully documented for ServiceCallout, and root Properties appears only in a sample. HTTP/local target and authentication token alternatives are not enforceable by static requiredChildren.

title: set dialogflow response policy
reviewNotes: Reviewed CX-only DialogflowVersion, APPEND/REPLACE MergeBehavior, and both phrase and parameter extraction branches with required Header/Parameter name attributes. The requirement to choose one of Header, JSONPath, Ref, or Value per Phrase/Parameter is not expressible by the static requiredChildren model.

title: set integration request policy
reviewNotes: Reviewed required IntegrationRegion/ApiTrigger, ref-or-literal variants, input parameters and arrays, data-type enums, schedule and request variable. ApiTrigger prefix and ScheduleTime format prose conflict with unprefixed/spaced examples, so those text formats remain free. ParameterArray type includes json because a dedicated JSON-array example contradicts the narrower attribute table.

title: set oauth v2 info policy
reviewNotes: Reviewed required AccessToken and Attributes, variable-or-literal access token, and repeatable custom Attribute with name/ref or literal value. The Attribute name presence cell is blank, but the prose says it identifies the custom property; name is therefore required for useful configuration.

title: spike arrest policy
reviewNotes: Reviewed Rate syntax and ref, Identifier/MessageWeight references, and Apigee X-only UseEffectiveCount support. Although examples and documented default show false, the page explicitly states rate smoothing/false is unsupported for Apigee organizations, so only true is proposed for X. Properties appears in the default XML but has no element reference and remains incomplete. Rate ref-only is valid and does not need literal text.

title: trace capture policy
reviewNotes: Reviewed trace variable names/references, defaults, and boolean flags. The root summary calls Variables optional but its detailed section calls it required; root requiredness is therefore not enforced. An unrelated MergeBehavior entry appears in the child summary with no syntax or detailed reference and is not proposed. The IgnoreUnresolvedVariables default is also contradictory on this page.

title: validate saml assertion policy
reviewNotes: Reviewed root options, Source name choices, namespace/XPath configuration, required TrustStore, and RemoveAssertion. The page gives only a field table rather than full element/attribute descriptions; its SourceNotConfigured deployment error still names deprecated XPath even though the sample uses AssertionXPath and SignedElementXPath. Those child requiredness rules and namespace prefix requiredness are left conservative.

title: verify api key policy
reviewNotes: Reviewed policy elements, attributes, requiredness, and the documented cache-expiry range for Apigee. The deprecated async attribute is recognized without validating an undocumented value set.

title: verify iam policy
reviewNotes: Apigee-only (not hybrid) policy. Reviewed all documented configuration elements, attributes, and optional CredentialSource behavior.

title: verify jws policy
reviewNotes: Apigee X policy. Documented configuration paths and attribute values are covered. Algorithm accepts comma-separated values; the format rule checks supported names, while family-mixing and the conditional PublicKey/SecretKey or JWKS/Value choice remain unmodeled cross-field constraints.

title: verify jwt policy
reviewNotes: Apigee X signed and encrypted JWT forms are reviewed. PasswordKey and DirectKey are shown in the encrypted-key table but their complete verification-side child contracts are delegated or absent on this page; CustomClaims is explicitly ignored. Exactly-one Algorithm/Algorithms and algorithm-dependent key choices remain cross-field constraints, not unconditional required-child rules.

title: xml json policy
reviewNotes: Apigee X XMLToJSON configuration is reviewed. Options and Format are mutually exclusive and one is required; this cross-field choice is not enforced by unconditional required-child rules. NamespaceBlockName requires its two companion options, also retained as a documented conditional constraint.

title: xml threat protection policy
reviewNotes: Apigee X XML threat-protection paths and limit formats are reviewed. The reference headings say StructuralLimits but every configuration sample uses StructureLimits; only the sample spelling is modeled. ChildCount samples use includeProcessingInstruction while the attribute table says includeProcessingInstructions; both are provisionally accepted pending authoritative clarification.

title: xsl transform policy
reviewNotes: Apigee X XSL policy XML is reviewed; XSLT resource contents remain outside extension scope. The page lists only root name but common policy attributes are included provisionally to avoid false unknown-attribute diagnostics. Parameter ref/value are alternatives and cannot be simultaneously enforced by the current data schema.
